description: Defines the Loop class for managing event loops with thread-local lazy initialization, callbacks, and timers, using uSockets library.

classes.name: Loop
classes.description: Manages event loop creation, callbacks, timers, and thread-local lazy initialization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the thread-local singleton instance of Loop, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees the loop, stopping timers and releasing resources.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Defers a callback to be executed in the loop's thread.

methods.name: integrate
methods.description: Integrates the loop with external event loops (e.g., Node.js).

methods.name: setSilent
methods.description: Sets the loop to silent mode.
